item.title: Patch: Authorization bypass and command injection in Barracuda Email Security Gateway and other Barracuda products
item.description:
Barracuda Email Security Gateway: RCE · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for Barracuda Email Security Gateway. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

High · Fix available
